scripts.format: oxfmt collector sdk/node docs package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json README.md development_docs .github
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check collector sdk/node docs package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json README.md development_docs .github
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @offprint/collector test && pnpm --filter offprint run build:test && pnpm --filter offprint test
